summary_en: FY3/27 annual dividend raised to ¥83/share from ¥69 forecast. Intermediate dividend increased ¥5 to ¥33/share; final dividend increased ¥9 to ¥50/share. Increase reflects upward earnings revision (consolidated net income forecast raised ¥1.4B for full year to ¥7.1B) driven by yen weakness and stronger-than-expected maintenance demand. Target payout ratio ~30%.
title_en: Notice of Business Forecast Revision and Dividend Forecast Revision (Dividend Increase)
translation_en_brief:
Daihatsu Infinearth announced a revision to its FY3/27 (ending March 2027) dividend forecast and upward earnings guidance on July 31, 2026.

Dividend increase: The company raised its full-year dividend forecast to ¥83 per share from the previously guided ¥69. The intermediate (semi-annual) dividend was increased by ¥5 to ¥33/share, and the final dividend was raised by ¥9 to ¥50/share. This marks the first material dividend growth after a period of flat payouts (prior year FY3/26 paid ¥69 annually).

Earnings revision: Consolidated net income for FY3/27 was upgraded ¥1.4B to ¥7.1B (full year), and the intermediate period (April–September 2026) profit was raised ¥800M to ¥2.9B. The revision reflects two drivers: yen weakness beyond initial budget assumptions, and stronger-than-expected maintenance-related demand. The company operates under a stated dividend policy targeting a 30% consolidated payout ratio with a ¥15/share minimum floor.

The dividend increase aligns with the company's medium-term vision to balance growth capital investment and shareholder returns.
